title: Winding river dreams
content: I frequently have dreams of a bright blue winding river sometimes its rushing sometimes lazy but it's outside and the sun sparkles off the water the sky is beautiful puffy clouds just an overall nice day but the river winds through buildings like bars and casinos and they're like open spaces with tall chairs and tables and the bar top and it's watereverywhere inside and you stop at those places see people you haven't seen in for ever catch up with them an then leave and flow and wind your way to the next spot it's one of my weirdest dreams because it seems so normal like oh I'm just floating down the river fully clothed with shoes on walking around a flooded open faced casino like tiki bar every couple miles but there's no boat just me floating.
